beats.say: Your wait for GTA 6 is nearly over: 19 November 2026.
Xbox Wire says the official launch trailer landed on 23 October 2026, and it invites you to explore Leonida.
So what do you actually get on day one?
It arrives on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S at launch.
But the BBC says multiplayer modes won't be available at launch.
So on 19 November, you will not be playing multiplayer.
Are you playing on day one?

facts: The official Grand Theft Auto VI launch trailer was posted on 23 October 2026.
The trailer invites players to explore Leonida before the game arrives on November 19.
Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled to be released on 19 November 2026.
GTA 6 will be released on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S at launch.
Multiplayer modes won't be available at launch.
